limitations: Real truth is TP1 pseudo-reference, not an independent measured robot pose.
Nearby real scans selected by estimated distance under 1 m, without physical displacement verification.
Initial perturbations are relative to the known or pseudo-reference pose, not estimates available automatically on a robot.
Three annealing seeds and repeated starts are correlated computational trials.
